consigna: Friday, spoken: talk for 90 seconds about a place you go to often — what it looks like and what you do there. Note two or three ideas first, then speak freely.
requisitos: Describe a place with three adjectives (week 15)
One routine in the present simple (week 17)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Look at your corrections from weeks 14 to 21 and write down the mistake that was marked most often.
*Wed (5 min).* Write three correct sentences about that mistake. No more.
*Fri (5 min).* Record 90 seconds. Then listen and look for the mistake.
autochequeo: Did I describe the place, or only say I like it?
Did I mix present simple and present continuous?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of three things at A2 level: describing a place, present simple for routines, and comparatives. (1) For each one, say if it is there and if it is correct. (2) Tell me my most frequent mistake. (3) Give me one sentence with all three. Correct nothing else. ---
